notes:
Tasks, redesigned and simpler.

Two cards at the top, Assigned to me and Assigned by me, and In the loop for tasks
you are kept informed on. Under them, six figures: Total, Not Accepted Yet, Overdue,
In Progress, Under Review and Completed. Tap one to see only those tasks. The figures
stay put while you search. The list opens with the latest due date first.

Every task shows who gave it, who it is for and the day it was assigned, and has a
status menu: approve, reject, delegate, transfer, send for review or complete. Filter
by department, person, due date and priority, or search by who gave the task or who
it is for. Anyone can give anyone a task; leave the person empty to assign it to
yourself. If the Super Admin allows it, you can set a task on someone else's behalf.
Splitting a task starts with choosing the person. "Ask" is gone.

Home: Quick actions has a search box, and you can hold a tile and drag it to a new
place.

Faster: your task lists open straight away from what you saw last, while the latest
loads. Signing out now removes that saved data from the phone.

Approvals: every approval list has a History tab. Admins, the CEO and the MD have one
Approvals instead of two.

Alerts: swipe a notification right to mark it read (or unread again). Swipe left and
tap Delete to remove it.

Payslips have separate View and Share buttons. Documents, bills, letters and other
PDFs or photos now open to view instead of going straight to share.

Lists you pick from open with the cursor already in the search box.

Salary advance requests are now the company's Advance Request Form: purpose, date of
disbursement, repayment months and the terms to accept. An advance can be up to three
months' salary.

The home-screen interview card keeps a round until its result is recorded, and rounds
on hold are listed separately.

Dark mode: dark, green and red buttons (such as Run payroll) are readable again. The
CEO and MD can open Payroll and Payslip Requests in view-only mode too.
